neighbours.label: A word-initial prefix piece of a split Greek-derived technical term (' ultr' in ultr|amafic, ' met' in met|azoans, ' pol' in pol|ycyclic), vs prefixed terms that are single tokens or split differently
fire: The island is built on ultrabasic rocks rich in olivine.
Sponges are among the simplest metazoans in the sea.
She was diagnosed with polycystic ovary syndrome last year.
Wear sunscreen to block ultraviolet radiation at high altitude.
The hormone is a short polypeptide made in the pancreas.
Samples were spun in an ultracentrifuge for two hours.
Early metazoan fossils appear in rocks from the Ediacaran period.
Burning coal releases polycyclic compounds into the air.

notes: Card: ' met' x4, ' pol' x3, ' ultr' x2, ' extr' x2, ' par'.
